messages:
Priya: quick sync — we need a compact acceptance rubric for design partners that captures jurisdictional gating (EU/US/APAC) and availability windows. goal: 3-week onboarding + 8-week feedback loop. :wave:
Anil: +1. Clarify: legal/regulatory gating (data residency, GDPR) vs operational (SLA, maintenance windows)?
Priya: both. we want to avoid late surprises for private/dedicated customers — capture upfront where they cannot host data outside region and their preferred feedback cadence.
Sam: suggest adding a lightweight availability matrix in intake: timezone overlap, committed engineers, weekly touchpoints, and any blackout windows. low lift, high signal.
Jia: propose 3 scoring buckets: Eligibility (security/compliance), Commitment (time + engagement), Fit (workload representativeness). score 0-3 each.
Beth: agree. call out hard blockers vs negotiable items. e.g., hard blocker = must sign DPA; negotiable = invoice frequency.
Priya: draft intake checklist below — paste into intake doc and comment.
Priya: ```
INTAKE CHECKLIST (one-liner answers)
- Region/jurisdiction: (US / EU / APAC / Hybrid)
- Data residency required? (Y/N + details)
- Requires private deployment? (Y/N)
- DPA/legal OK? (Y/N)
- Timezone overlap (hours/week)
- Dedicated eng contact (name + weekly hours)
- Primary workload archetype (chat/generation/embeddings/rerank)
- Success metric (latency p95, cost target, accuracy baseline)
- Preferred feedback cadence (weekly async / weekly sync / biweekly / monthly)
- Can commit to 8-week evaluation tasks? (Y/N)
- Maintenance blackout windows (local dates/times)
- Rollback acceptance: what would trigger immediate rollback? (short note)
- Escalation contact + SLA expectations
```
Anil: add 'rollback acceptance' — what they consider intolerable regressions so we can A/B and roll back quickly.
Sam: also include a 3-question micro-survey we'll push at weeks 2/4/8 to keep responses high. multiple choice.
Jia: micro-survey samples: 1) "Does integration meet latency & correctness expectations? (Yes / Mostly / Not yet)" 2) "Are weekly touchpoints useful? (Yes / Somewhat / No)" 3) "Recommend continuing? (Yes / Maybe / No)"
Beth: legal check: @legal-bot do we need separate DPAs per region or is standard DPA + SCCs sufficient?
legal-bot: (automated) Standard DPA + SCCs covers EU cross-border transfers. If customer requires on-prem/local-only deployment, escalate to Legal for a bespoke agreement.
Priya: mark 'DPA required' as hard blocker. Jia, can you draft the 0-3 scoring definitions? keep it succinct.
Jia: draft scoring: 0 = fails requirement (disqualify). 1 = minimal compliance, high caveats. 2 = acceptable fit, some work needed. 3 = ideal match. Weighting: Eligibility x2, Commitment x1.5, Fit x1. Example normalized score = floor((elig*2 + commit*1.5 + fit*1) / 4.5 * 10). Threshold >=7 to accept.
Sam: ops ask: capture maintenance blackout windows to avoid rollout surprises. Also add a pre-seeded prompt set and automated acceptance harness to onboarding for regression detection.
Priya: noted. Owner questions: who runs recruitment outreach and screening call?
Beth: Product handles first 20 screens. If DPA/private deploy flagged, Customer Success joins screening.
Jia: timeline: outreach (wk0-2), screening + checklist (wk2), onboarding (wk3), evaluation (wk4-11), wrap/handoff (wk12).
Priya: I'll publish checklist in dp intake doc by EOW and ping reviewers. will add micro-survey + acceptance harness tasks. :thumbsup:
Anil: thanks — make sure intake includes contact availability and staffing commitments.
Sam: :rocket:
Beth: cc @legal-bot for visibility.
legal-bot: (automated) Logged: DP intake flagged for manual review when 'private deployment' = yes.
Priya: closing loop. publishing and tagging for review. Thanks everyone.
